scripts.features:
Rolling & Luck
Auto Roll Slimes with an adjustable Roll Delay slider — push it as fast as your executor can handle
Smart Special Roll Manager — automatically holds your Special Rolls whenever no luck boost is active, so you never burn them for nothing
Auto Equip Best keeps your strongest team slotted at all times
Roll Alerts
Sound Alert the second something rare drops
Discord Webhook support — get pinged with the slime, the odds, and your name
Set your own rarity threshold so you only hear about the pulls that actually matter
Dice & Spins
Auto-arm every special: Jackpot Spins, Inverted, Shiny, Huge, and Big Dice — set it and forget it
Farming & Combat
Auto Farm Slimes + Auto Shoot Slime Gun for hands-off grinding
Efficient Farm mode reads your live kill/coin/goop rates and parks you in the most profitable zone automatically
Live stats readout: team damage, kills/sec, coins/sec, goop/sec, optimal zone, and rebirth ETA
One-tap teleports: Best Zone, UFO drops, and the Crafter
Collection
Auto Loot Vacuum sweeps up coins, fruit, drops, and goop
Auto TP to UFO so you're never late to alien drops
Progression
Auto Rebirth with a rebirth cap and active-boost protection so it never rebirths through your buffs
Auto Buy Zones and Auto Buy Upgrades
Skip Tutorial instantly + Claim Group Luck for the permanent boost
Manual Zone Teleport to anywhere you've unlocked
Slimes, Feeding & Upgrades
Auto Feed Equipped — target your whole team or one specific slime, with a stop-at-level so you don't overfeed
Auto Upgrade Slimes through the full element trees (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Sword, Magic, Universe) with an optional Use Fruits mode for origins
Transfer Idle XP in one click
Fruits & XP Machines
Auto Extract Fruits, plus manual Unlock Extractor / Extract All / Reclaim Fed Fruits
Unlock XP Transfer machine support
Crafting
Auto Craft any selected recipe and Auto TP to Crafter — pick the recipe, walk away
Boosters
Auto-activate Luck, Ultra Luck, Currency, and Roll Speed boosts — all at once or one selected
Protect Active Boosts so nothing gets wasted
Codes
Redeem Entered Code for anything you type in, or Redeem All Codes to sweep every active code (list auto-updates from a live source)
Slime Database
Full in-menu Slime Lookup: rarity, damage, stats, source zone, and Copy Image ID
Quick references for Rarest Slimes, Craftable Slimes, Mutation Odds, and overall DB Stats
Quality of Life
Anti-AFK so you never get kicked, and Auto Rejoin if you do
Auto Claim Index rewards, Auto Unlock Recipes, and offline earnings claimed on load
Interface
Smooth Fluent UI with config save/load and theme options
RightShift to open/close on PC, or use the draggable on-screen button on mobile
Light, stable, and pcall-protected so a single hiccup never crashes your session
